QuestInfo.name: Special Taste of Florina Beach IV
QuestInfo.0: #p802# is trying to develop a special dish in #m10007000#.
QuestInfo.1: I need to collect ingredients that will help further cultivate the special taste of #m10007000#: #b10 #t4000061#s#k, #b10 #t4000032#s#k, #b10 #t4000040#s#k, and #b10 #t4000031#s#k. Will #p800#'s new recipe succeed?
QuestInfo.2: I was familiar with working in #m10007000#, so I visited #p802# one more time and helped her out. Why is she so desperate to help #p800#?

0.0: I have a job for you now. All you need to do is gather up a few ingredients. What do you think? Do you want to do it?

yes.0: Drop by every once in a while, and I'll have some work for you. What do you think? Isn't that cool? Valen's been trying to come up with new dishes lately, and it seems he needs more fresh ingredients... Bring me #b10 each of #t4000061#s#k, #b#t4000031#s#k, #b#t4000032#s#k, and #b#t4000040#s#k. What do you think?

no.0: Oh, really? Well, it's not something I need right this minute, so take your time, see if you want to do it. If you do, then come talk to me, all right? Well, I gotta get going...

1.0: Did you gather them all up? Let's see...

yes.0: As usual!! You're as accurate as ever! You really handle tasks better than anyone I've seen so far. If something comes up again someday, I think I'll be able to count on you. And as a reward, I'll let Uncle #p112# at #m10000000# know that you can come to #m10007000# for free anytime from now on. See you around.

item.0: I don't think you have all of the ingredients. Please check again.
